2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型

Executive Summary

本报告评估 DeepAgents 与 DSH 两个候选平台。DeepAgents 是构建于 LangGraph 之上的 LangChain 执行框架，适合作为核心路由与执行层 [source_001]。DSH 保留用于外部验证环境，不进入核心路由循环 [source_004]。基准测试要求固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算及关键路径延迟 [source_007]。建议采用混合方案：DeepAgents 负责执行，DSH 负责外部验证。

Background

2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型需要可测量的路由基准。DeepAgents 作为 LangChain 框架构建于 LangGraph 之上，提供图式控制流 [source_001]。DSH 被明确保留用于外部验证环境，而非核心路由循环，以避免污染内部基准 [source_004]。基准设计要求固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算及关键路径延迟 [source_007]。

Selection Criteria

选型标准包括：支持固定任务 DAG、容纳多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算及关键路径延迟测量 [source_007]。执行平台需具备图原生设计，验证平台需保持测量隔离。DeepAgents 满足执行侧要求 [source_001]，DSH 满足验证侧隔离要求 [source_004]。

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph，提供通用 Agent 编排与图式控制流，适合作为主路由框架，但需额外叠加成本核算与评分工具 [source_001]。DSH 保留用于外部验证环境，不进入核心路由循环，从而保持质量、成本与关键路径延迟测量的完整性 [source_004]。基准需求由 DeepAgents 的图原生设计更好满足 [source_007]。

Risks

主要风险是 DeepAgents 的通用性带来仪表化开销，成本核算与逐节点评分需额外叠加，可能扰动关键路径延迟测量 [source_001][source_007]。DSH 若进入核心路由循环会污染基准，因此必须保持外部验证定位 [source_004]。混合方案需防止验证逻辑渗入执行层。

Conclusion

建议采用混合架构：DeepAgents 作为执行基底，承载固定任务 DAG、多候选模型与评分 [source_001][source_007]；DSH 保留用于外部验证环境，确保测量可信 [source_004]。该方案兼顾灵活性与验证完整性。

References

[source_001] DeepAgents: DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph. [source_004] DeepSeek Harness: DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop. [source_007] Benchmark design: A useful routing benchmark needs fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency.

Source Trace

  • DeepAgents — DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph.
  • DeepSeek Harness — DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop.
  • Benchmark design — A useful routing benchmark needs fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency.

judge.rationale: The report successfully includes all required sections (Executive Summary, Background, Selection Criteria, Platform Comparison, Risks, Conclusion, References) with proper HTML5 structure and semantic markup. All three expected claims are present and accurately supported by the frozen sources. The Chinese-language report demonstrates good readability and logical flow. However, the analysis depth is limited by the narrow scope of sources utilized—only 3 of 8 provided sources (source_001, source_004, source_007) are cited, omitting relevant context from source_002 (LangGraph technical details), source_003 (Pydantic AI), source_005 (research gap), source_006 (task decomposition boundary), and source_008 (scoring rubric). The HTML is valid with proper DOCTYPE, meta tags, and structural elements, though the References section could be more formally structured.
